segs.en: C. Canal Crossing

zh.ai: C. 运河穿越

segs.en: ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d677104ccb4379b02b4cc7ccd81cef7737d2a9c4.png)

zh.ai: ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d677104ccb4379b02b4cc7ccd81cef7737d2a9c4.png)

segs.en: Pixabay Content Licence by blaze_rob on Pixabay

zh.ai: Pixabay 上 blaze_rob 发布的内容，适用 Pixabay 内容许可协议。

segs.en: To escape from the Christmas market hassle, you are planning a trip to Venice to see its beautiful canals and its many bridges. Unfortunately, you do not seem to be the only person with that plan, and Venice recently decided to charge for that pleasure. Therefore, you decide that crossing each bridge once is enough for you. Fortunately, every place can be reached from any other using only streets, without crossing any bridges. Interestingly, there is exactly one way to reach any other place using only streets.

zh.ai: 为了逃离圣诞集市的喧闹，你计划前往威尼斯，欣赏那里美丽的运河和众多桥梁。不幸的是，似乎不止你有这个打算，而且威尼斯最近决定对这项乐趣收费。因此，你决定每座桥只走一次就够了。幸运的是，只走街道、不经过任何桥梁，就能从任意地点到达其他地点。有趣的是，这样的路线恰好只有一条。

segs.en: After you gathered all this knowledge, now all that is left is to plan a trip that crosses each bridge exactly once. To keep things interesting, you also want to use each street at most once. What is the length of the shortest possible trip? Note that your tour can start at any place you choose, but it has to end where it starts.

zh.ai: 收集完所有这些知识后，剩下的就是规划一条恰好经过每座桥一次的路线。为了增加趣味，你还希望每条街最多经过一次。最短路线的长度是多少？注意，你可以选择任意地点作为起点，但路线必须回到起点。

segs.en: ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9e899604546bfcd477d8cca790016d74cbe56847.png)

zh.ai: ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9e899604546bfcd477d8cca790016d74cbe56847.png)

segs.en: Illustration of Sample Input 1 with a tour of length $$$45$$$.

zh.ai: 长度为 $$$45$$$ 的游览路线示例输入 1 的示意图。

segs.en: The input consists of:

zh.ai: 输入包括：

segs.en: One line with an integer $$$n$$$ ($$$3\leq n\leq 10^5$$$), the number of places in Venice.

zh.ai: 一行包含一个整数 $$$n$$$($$$3\leq n\leq 10^5$$$)，表示威尼斯的地点数量。

segs.en: $$$n-1$$$ lines, each with three integers $$$a$$$, $$$b$$$, and $$$w$$$ ($$$1\leq a,b\leq n$$$, $$$a \neq b$$$, $$$1\leq w\leq10^6$$$), the starting and ending place of each street and its length.

zh.ai: $$$n-1$$$ 行，每行包含三个整数 $$$a$$$、$$$b$$$ 和 $$$w$$$($$$1\leq a,b\leq n$$$、$$$a \neq b$$$、$$$1\leq w\leq10^6$$$)，分别表示每条街道的起点、终点及其长度。

segs.en: One line with an integer $$$m$$$ ($$$1\leq m\leq5\cdot10^5$$$), the number of bridges in Venice.

zh.ai: 一行一个整数 $$$m$$$($$$1\leq m\leq5\cdot10^5$$$)，表示威尼斯的桥梁数量。

segs.en: $$$m$$$ lines, each with two integers $$$a$$$ and $$$b$$$ ($$$1\leq a,b\leq n$$$, $$$a \neq b$$$), the places where each bridge starts and ends.

zh.ai: $$$m$$$ 行，每行包含两个整数 $$$a$$$ 和 $$$b$$$($$$1\leq a,b\leq n$$$， $$$a \neq b$$$)，表示每座桥的起点和终点。

segs.en: Bridges are short, and thus have length zero.

zh.ai: 桥很短，因此长度为零。

segs.en: It is guaranteed that every place can be reached from any other place without using any bridges. Further, no bridge connects two places which are directly connected by a street, and all bridges are between distinct pairs of places. Lastly, it is guaranteed that at least one tour exists that crosses each bridge exactly once and uses every street at most once.

zh.ai: 保证不使用任何桥时，每个地点都可以从其他任意地点到达。此外，没有一座桥连接两个由街道直接相连的地点，并且所有桥连接的都是不同的地点对。最后，保证至少存在一条路线，使其恰好经过每座桥一次，并且每条街道至多使用一次。

segs.en: Output the length of the shortest tour that crosses all bridges and uses each street at most once.

zh.ai: 输出经过所有桥且每条街最多使用一次的最短巡游路线长度。

segs.en: B. Bisecting Bargain

zh.ai: B. 平分特价

segs.en: ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e4020306c19625a6422f67c002d2d4eeb5bd1324.png)

zh.ai: ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e4020306c19625a6422f67c002d2d4eeb5bd1324.png)

segs.en: Illustration of Sample Output 4.   Photo by Jeroen Op de Beek

zh.ai: 样例输出 4 的示意图。照片由 Jeroen Op de Beek 拍摄。

segs.en: Emilia and Alex love Christmas markets. There are so many stalls to explore and so many delicious foods to try! The options seem endless: Schupfnudeln with Sauerkraut, langos, crêpes, roasted almonds, Bratwurst, twister fries and much more.

zh.ai: Emilia 和 Alex 都很喜欢圣诞集市。那里有许多摊位可以逛，还有各种美味的食物可以品尝！选择似乎无穷无尽：配酸菜的土豆面疙瘩、兰戈斯、可丽饼、烤杏仁、德国香肠、螺旋薯条，还有更多美食。

segs.en: Here in Germany, some stalls still do not accept credit cards, so Emilia and Alex need to withdraw some cash from a nearby cash machine (also called an ATM, or Automated Teller Machine). Due to some fees, it is cheaper to withdraw all the cash they need at once, so they plan to do so.

zh.ai: 在德国，一些摊位仍然不接受信用卡，因此 Emilia 和 Alex 需要从附近的取款机（也称 ATM，即 Automated Teller Machine）取一些现金。由于手续费的缘故，一次性取出所需的全部现金更便宜，所以他们计划这样做。

segs.en: This particular cash machine works in the following way: the user inputs an integer $$$x$$$, and then the machine chooses a selection of coins and banknotes that sums to €$$$x$$$. The cash machine can dispense all possible Euro coins and notes with values €$$$1$$$ and up: €$$$1$$$, €$$$2$$$, €$$$5$$$, €$$$10$$$, €$$$20$$$, €$$$50$$$, €$$$100$$$, €$$$200$$$, and €$$$500$$$. It has sufficiently many coins and notes of each type to form any combination that sums to $$$x$$$, and you do not know in advance which of these combinations it will dispense.

zh.ai: 这台自动取款机的工作方式如下：用户输入一个整数 $$$x$$$，然后机器会选择若干硬币和纸币，使其总额为 €$$$x$$$。这台自动取款机可以发放所有面值为 €$$$1$$$ 及以上的欧元硬币和纸币：€$$$1$$$、€$$$2$$$、€$$$5$$$、€$$$10$$$、€$$$20$$$、€$$$50$$$、€$$$100$$$、€$$$200$$$ 和 €$$$500$$$。它备有足够数量的各种面值硬币和纸币，可以组成总额为 $$$x$$$ 的任意组合，而你事先并不知道它会发放哪一种组合。

segs.en: Since Emilia and Alex plan to visit some different stalls independently, they want to split the withdrawn amount evenly between them. While waiting in the long queue in front of the cash machine, Emilia suddenly realizes that this might not be possible, depending on which coins and banknotes the cash machine dispenses. For example, €$$$42$$$ might not be evenly splittable (see Sample 1), whereas no matter how €$$$40$$$ is dispensed by the cash machine, the cash can always be divided into two piles of €$$$20$$$.

zh.ai: 由于 Emilia 和 Alex 计划分别前往一些不同的摊位，他们希望将取出的金额平均分给两人。在取款机前排着长队等待时，Emilia 突然意识到，这取决于取款机吐出的硬币和纸币，金额可能无法平均分配。例如，€$$$42$$$ 可能无法平均分配(见样例 1)；而无论取款机如何吐出 €$$$40$$$，现金总能被分成两堆，每堆 €$$$20$$$。

segs.en: Can the money always be split evenly if they withdraw €$$$n$$$ from the cash machine?

zh.ai: 如果他们从自动取款机取出 €$$$n$$$，总能将这笔钱平均分配吗？

segs.en: The input consists of:

zh.ai: 输入包括：

segs.en: One line with an integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1\leq n\leq 10\,000$$$), the amount of cash in € that Emilia and Alex want to withdraw in total.

zh.ai: 一行包含一个整数 $$$n$$$ ($$$1\leq n\leq 10\,000$$$)，表示 Emilia 和 Alex 想要提取的现金总额(欧元)。

segs.en: If the money can always be split evenly, output "splittable". Otherwise, output the number of coins and notes, followed by their values, such that the values add to $$$n$$$ and the money cannot be split evenly.

zh.ai: 如果钱总是可以均分，输出“splittable”。否则，输出硬币和纸币的数量，随后输出它们的面值，使得这些面值之和为 $$$n$$$，且这些钱无法均分。

segs.en: If there are multiple ways of choosing coins and notes that are not splittable, you may output any one of them.

zh.ai: 如果存在多种选择硬币和不可拆分纸币的方式，你可以输出其中任意一种。

segs.en: H. Popsicle Stick Game

zh.ai: H. 冰棒棍游戏

segs.en: Dinny and Walrus are working on an arts and crafts project! They have $$$n$$$ popsicle sticks, where the $$$i$$$-th stick has a non-negative integer $$$a_i$$$ written on it.

zh.ai: Dinny 和 Walrus 正在制作手工艺品！他们有 $$$n$$$ 根冰棒棍，其中第 $$$i$$$ 根上写着一个非负整数 $$$a_i$$$。

segs.en: To decide who gets to keep their masterpiece, they play a game. Dinny goes first, and the two players alternate turns until all popsicle sticks have been removed.

zh.ai: 为了决定谁能留下自己的杰作，他们开始了一场游戏。Dinny 先手，两名玩家轮流行动，直到所有冰棒棍都被移除。

segs.en: On each turn, the current player performs the following actions in order:

zh.ai: 每个回合中，当前玩家依次执行以下操作：

segs.en: Add the $$$\mathrm{MEX}^\dagger$$$ of the numbers written on the remaining popsicle sticks to their score.

zh.ai: 将剩余冰棒棍上写的数字之 $$$\mathrm{MEX}^\dagger$$$ 加到他们的得分中。

segs.en: Choose any remaining popsicle stick and remove it.

zh.ai: 选择任意一根剩余的冰棒棍并将其移除。

segs.en: Both players start with a score of $$$0$$$. After all popsicle sticks have been removed, the player with the higher score wins. If both players have the same score, the game ends in a tie.

zh.ai: 两名玩家的初始得分均为 $$$0$$$。移除所有冰棒棍后，得分较高的玩家获胜。如果两名玩家的得分相同，则游戏以平局结束。

segs.en: Assuming both players play optimally, determine whether Dinny wins, Walrus wins, or the game ends in a tie.

zh.ai: 假设双方都采取最优策略，判断 Dinny 获胜、Walrus 获胜，还是游戏以平局结束。

segs.en: $$$^\dagger$$$The $$$\mathrm{MEX}$$$ (minimum excluded value) of an array is the smallest non-negative integer that is not in the array. For example:

zh.ai: $$$^\dagger$$$ 数组的 $$$\mathrm{MEX}$$$(最小未出现值)是数组中未出现的最小非负整数。例如：

segs.en: The $$$\mathrm{MEX}$$$ of $$$[2, 2, 1]$$$ is $$$0$$$ because $$$0$$$ is not in the array.
The $$$\mathrm{MEX}$$$ of $$$[3, 1, 0, 1]$$$ is $$$2$$$ because $$$0$$$ and $$$1$$$ are in the array but $$$2$$$ is not.
The $$$\mathrm{MEX}$$$ of $$$[0, 3, 1, 2]$$$ is $$$4$$$ because $$$0$$$, $$$1$$$, $$$2$$$ and $$$3$$$ are in the array but $$$4$$$ is not.
The first line contains an integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$) — the number of popsicle sticks.

zh.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 $$$n$$$($$$1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$)——冰棒棍的数量。

segs.en: The second line contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$$$ ($$$0 \le a_i \le 10^9$$$) — the numbers written on the popsicle sticks.

zh.ai: 第二行包含 $$$n$$$ 个整数 $$$a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$$$ ($$$0 \le a_i \le 10^9$$$)，表示写在冰棒棍上的数字。

segs.en: Output "Dinny", "Walrus", or "Tie", according to the winner. The capitalization of these names does not matter.

zh.ai: 根据获胜者输出“Dinny”、“Walrus”或“Tie”。这些名称的大小写不影响判定。

segs.en: In the first test case, one possible sequence of moves is:

zh.ai: 在第一个测试用例中，一种可能的操作序列是：

segs.en: Dinny earns $$$3$$$ points and removes the stick labeled $$$1$$$, leaving $$$[0,0,2]$$$.
Walrus earns $$$1$$$ point and removes a stick labeled $$$0$$$, leaving $$$[0,2]$$$.

zh.ai: Walrus 获得 $$$1$$$ 分，并移除一根标记为 $$$0$$$ 的木棍，剩下 $$$[0,2]$$$。

segs.en: Dinny earns $$$1$$$ point and removes the remaining stick labeled $$$0$$$, leaving $$$[2]$$$.

zh.ai: Dinny 获得 $$$1$$$ 分，并移除剩下的标号为 $$$0$$$ 的木棍，留下 $$$[2]$$$。

segs.en: Walrus earns $$$0$$$ points and removes the final stick.

zh.ai: Walrus 得到 $$$0$$$ 分，并移除最后一根棍子。

segs.en: Dinny finishes with $$$4$$$ points, while Walrus finishes with $$$1$$$ point. Therefore, Dinny wins.

zh.ai: Dinny 最终得到 $$$4$$$ 分，而 Walrus 最终得到 $$$1$$$ 分。因此，Dinny 获胜。

segs.en: In the second test case, since there is no stick labeled $$$0$$$, the MEX remains $$$0$$$ throughout the game. Neither player earns any points, so the game ends in a tie.

zh.ai: 在第二个测试用例中，由于没有标号为 $$$0$$$ 的木棍，MEX 在整个游戏过程中始终为 $$$0$$$。两位玩家都不会获得任何分数，因此游戏以平局结束。

segs.en: I. DINO Network

zh.ai: I. DINO 网络

segs.en: Researchers at Meta have been working on a self-supervised learning model for images called DINO. However, not all researchers seem to be equally working on the model. In particular, Johnny, one of the researchers, has been getting easily distracted at the team meetings.

zh.ai: Meta 的研究人员一直在开发一种名为 DINO 的图像自监督学习模型。然而，并非所有研究人员似乎都同样投入于该模型。特别是，其中一名研究人员 Johnny 在团队会议上很容易分心。

segs.en: For example, during the presentation this morning, a slide with a neural network containing a fully-connected layer appeared, and Johnny decided to start counting the number of unique intersection points that exist between the edges in the layer. However, Johnny realizes that doing this manually will take forever, and now he wants you to help him count the intersection points for him!

zh.ai: 例如，在今天早上的演示中，一张展示含有全连接层的神经网络的幻灯片出现了，Johnny 决定开始统计该层边之间存在的不同交点数量。然而，Johnny 意识到手动完成这项工作会耗费很长时间，因此他想让你帮忙统计交点数量！

segs.en: A fully-connected linear layer can be represented as a set of $$$n$$$ input nodes and $$$m$$$ output nodes with straight-line edges connecting every pair of input and output nodes. The input nodes are equally spaced on a vertical line, and the output nodes are equally spaced on another vertical line.

zh.ai: 一个全连接线性层可以表示为由 $$$n$$$ 个输入节点和 $$$m$$$ 个输出节点组成的结构，每一对输入节点与输出节点之间都由直线边相连。输入节点在一条竖直线上等距排列，输出节点则在另一条竖直线上等距排列。

segs.en: The first line contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$m$$$ ($$$2 \le n, m \le 1000$$$) – the number of input nodes and the number of output nodes of the fully-connected linear layer, respectively.

zh.ai: 第一行包含两个整数 $$$n$$$ 和 $$$m$$$ ($$$2 \le n, m \le 1000$$$)，分别表示全连接线性层的输入节点数和输出节点数。

segs.en: Output a single integer, the number of unique intersection points between the edges in the fully-connected linear layer. Nodes do not count as intersection points of edges.

zh.ai: 输出一个整数，表示完全连接线性层中各边之间不同交点的数量。节点不计作边的交点。

segs.en: In the example test case, there are $$$4$$$ input nodes and $$$3$$$ output nodes. From the diagram above, observe that there are $$$14$$$ unique intersection points by manual inspection.

zh.ai: 在样例测试用例中，有 $$$4$$$ 个输入节点和 $$$3$$$ 个输出节点。通过手动检查上面的示意图可以发现，共有 $$$14$$$ 个不同的交点。
